meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交、变基、搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用 Git 管理代码版本
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits, rebase, and search history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently use Git for version control

howto.what: Claude 会先分析仓库现状和最近提交消息的风格,把你的改动拆成多个独立小提交;需要时用 rebase、squash 整理提交历史,用 blame、bisect、log -S 查出改动是谁、何时、在哪次提交里引入的。
howto.when: 当你提出任何 Git 操作需求,尤其是说“commit”“rebase”“squash”等关键词,或询问代码是谁写的、某功能何时加入、找引入改动的提交时,Claude 会接管处理。

say.text: 帮我把当前改动拆成几个小提交,并按仓库风格写消息。
say.note: Claude 会先分析再分批提交。

say.text: 把这几个提交 squash 成一个,再 rebase 到主分支。
say.note: 触发历史重写,整理提交记录。

say.text: 这段代码是谁写的?什么时候加入的?
say.note: 会用 blame 和 log 定位原提交。

howto.what_en: Claude handles Git by inspecting repo state and recent commit message style, splits changes into multiple small commits, rewrites history via rebase/squash, and uses blame/bisect/log -S to find who/when/where a change was introduced.
howto.when_en: Activates on any Git request, especially keywords like 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', or questions about who wrote code, when something was added, or which commit introduced a change.

say_en.text: Split my current changes into small commits matching the repo style.
say_en.note: It analyzes then commits in batches.

say_en.text: Squash these commits into one and rebase onto the main branch.
Who wrote this code, and when was it added?
say_en.note: Uses blame and log to locate the commit.
